# Malta

[global-law](../) / Malta

1 repository under this folder (1 legislation, whole country). Each row links to the repository's current `main`; the folder of the same path is the submodule global-law pins and reads. "Coverage" is what the corpus says of itself; freshness is global-law's monitor.

## Completeness, checked against the official sources (2026-11-12)

| Constitution | Main codes | National law | Law-making regions | Case law |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| not held | 100% | 100% | not applicable | 0% |

Near-complete statute book without its Constitution: lexifina/malta-law holds all 562 Chapters and 4,522 pieces of subsidiary legislation on legislation.mt, with the five main codes current to 2026-10-01, but the Constitution of Malta (eli/const) is not in the tree and there is no case law. Only 30% of changes carry an in-force date because the 5,053 undated commits are each law's baseline text (dated by a 'Consolidated:' trailer, by design), not amendments.

Shares are of what exists, not of what each repository says it holds; estimates are marked, with their method in [data/completeness.json](../data/completeness.json).
